validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="xpath" initial="s">
  <datamodel><data id="x" expr="1"/></datamodel>
  <state id="s">
    <onentry><assign location="$x" expr="…"/></onentry>
    <transition event="go" cond="…" target="done"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: xpath syntax error in `expr`: `…` is a placeholder, not an expression
notes: an expression that cannot be parsed raises `error.execution` whenever it is evaluated
diagnostics.help: replace `…` with the expression this `expr` needs
spec_references: SCXML CR 2014 §C.3 The XPath Data Model

diagnostics.message: xpath syntax error in `cond`: `…` is a placeholder, not an expression
notes: a condition that cannot be parsed raises `error.execution` and evaluates as false, so this condition can never hold
diagnostics.help: replace `…` with the condition this `cond` needs
spec_references: SCXML CR 2014 §C.3 The XPath Data Model
